race.comment: PURPLE STREAK (4) is the clear horse to beat after resuming with a narrow third at Bendigo, where he was favourite and beaten only half a length by Prestige Lucky. His form last time in reads strongly and with the added fitness he really should be too slick. TEINE AULELEI (2) resumes from eight months off and brings Saturday-company form, having finished third at Caulfield behind Betwitchery before the break and with two trials since. 1000m is on the sharp side but she'll be running on. MISS OLE (3) has the G3 Manfred Stakes form line, where she was beaten a length and a half by Space Rider, and her latest close second trial at Cranbourne suggests she is forward enough to run well fresh. MCKEYLA (5) was second at Sale first-up after a start issue and being held up, she can improve and figure in the finish. BEST OF THE BEST (8) could be a surprise runner fresh.
